'''Ozu''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Ozu system/Legends|Ozu system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Isde Naha system/Legends|Isde Naha]] and [[Orn Kios system/Legends|Orn Kios systems]] of the neighboring [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ozu was a quiet world of sustenance [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]<ref name="GG" /> living on small [[Farm/Legends|farms]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was rarely visited by offworlders. A small<ref name="GG" /> [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] station was situated atop a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on Ozu. It was the most frequent reason for visits to the world by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="GG" />

After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Ozu was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ozu was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
